svg.aria-label: design-core: design from references, not adjectives. Twelve references feed three variants; the generic three-card variant is dropped and variant B is picked. A fresh critic scores each round, 6.1, 7.3, 8.2, 8.8, 9.4, until the score passes the 9.2 bar. The author's own score of 9.8 is set aside.
